title: toxicodendron glaucum
intro: Toxicodendron glaucum, commonly known as poison sumac, is a plant species belonging to the Anacardiaceae family, native to the southeastern United States. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which have been attributed to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of poison sumac include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and treat skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of poison sumac include tannins, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
